WITH valid_spatial AS (
  SELECT ss.*, p.fundflux
  FROM scanspatial ss
  JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
source_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM valid_spatial
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count)::numeric as total_count,
    AVG(count)::numeric as avg_count
  FROM source_counts
)
SELECT 
  sc.fundflux as source,
  sc.count,
  sc.count::numeric / t.total_count as share,
  sc.count::numeric - t.avg_count as above_average
FROM source_counts sc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE sc.count > t.avg_count
ORDER BY sc.count DESC;

assumptions.assumption: "Spatial survey coverage" means the count of spatial records (scanspatial rows) per funding source, not aggregated measurements like area or volume
"Share of the total" is calculated as each source's count divided by the sum of all source counts, including those below average, expressed as a decimal fraction
The average is the mean count per funding source: total spatial record count divided by the number of distinct funding sources with at least one spatial record

alternatives.interpretation: "Spatial survey coverage" could refer to aggregated surface area (sum of aream2) per funding source, applying the same filtering and calculations to area totals rather than record counts

  SELECT ss.*, p.fundflux
  FROM scanspatial ss
  JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
source_areas AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    SUM(aream2) as count
  FROM valid_spatial
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count)::numeric as total_count,
    AVG(count)::numeric as avg_count
  FROM source_areas
)
SELECT 
  sa.fundflux as source,
  sa.count,
  sa.count::numeric / t.total_count as share,
  sa.count::numeric - t.avg_count as above_average
FROM source_areas sa
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE sa.count > t.avg_count
ORDER BY sa.count DESC;
